data.name: Better Golfcarts
data.shortDescription: A utility mod to add small features to golf carts and also allow for some tuning.
data.description:
# Better Golfcarts is a utility mod which seeks to improve and tune various aspects of golf carts.


The mod currently changes the headlights of the golfcarts. Features include:

- Improved look of the headlights and removed the jagged edge to increase realism

- Added high beams, default hotkey H

- Added corner lighting, the lighting angle moves with your steering to light up corners better.

- Headlights can be configured to always be on.

Configuration can be done through the option menu. Headlights always on does not take effect until reboot.

### Corner lighting

Corner lighting is a feature commonly found on modern cars. The headlights move in the steering direction. This mod does the same thing.

The strength of the corner lighting can be adjusted in the settings. 1 means it directly mirrors your steering, where as 0 disables it entirely.

### Info


Multiplayer currently isn't supported (yet). It works on servers, but other players will see the default lighting.

versions.changelog: Restored the  'keep golfcart lights on' functionality that somehow got lost in patch 1.1

Hello everyone,

This patch fixes a small bug that caused the 'boost engaged' message to stay on the HUD even after exiting the cart.

# Better Golfcarts Patch 1.1
This patch adds some new features! 

- Added a parking brake. The parking brake can be toggled using the assigned keybind (default P). An icon should appear on the GPS screen indicating that the parking brake is active. The parking brake will keep the golfcart in place. Never run after your golfcart again!

- Added Boost functionality. Golfcarts now have a turbo boost that can be activated using a hotkey (default L). Enabling the boost will make the golfcart accelerate more agressively, but the handling gets worse. 

- Added Max Brake Torque This setting can be used to configure the maximum torque applied to the wheels by the brakes. Higher value means stronger brakes.

## Configuration
Ofcourse, everything can be configured!

- Added hotkey settings for boost and parking brake
- Boost strength can be customized or fully disabled.
- Maximum brake torque can be configured.
